statement: For the physical reflection block B_*=I_3-(2/3)11^T and ambient A=[[B_*,C],[C^T,D]], define S=D-C^T B_* C. After every deterministic translation, Schur completion produces sheet boundary b_t(Z)=(Z+t_Z)^T S(Z+t_Z). If S!=0, b_t(Z) is atomless and the majority sheet has a C_0 density of height at most pi sqrt(2); if S=0, the boundary is deterministic and rank(A)=3, while full-law continuity forces the two sheet-edge traces to match. In the whole chamber the designated account04/B14 physical-triple theorem gives ||p||_infinity<=6 sqrt(pi).
proof_mechanism: exact Schur completion in the original independent coordinates
translation-invariant identification of the outside Schur remainder S=D-C^T B_* C
account04/B14 atomless moving-boundary theorem for the majority sheet
account04/B14 physical-triple interval bound for the complete law
fixed-matrix same-constant C_0 compiler for the complete law
difference of continuous positive submeasure densities to obtain minority-sheet continuity when S!=0
account04/B15 atomic-boundary jump formula plus full-law continuity to match opposite sheet traces when S=0

actual_inequalities: sup_t ||p_((X+t)^T A (X+t))||_infinity <= 6 sqrt(pi) for every ambient extension of B_*
if S!=0 then ||p_majority,t||_infinity <= pi sqrt(2) and p_majority,t in C_0(R)

unresolved_implication: The bare condition s_3(A)>=1 still does not furnish a uniformly conditioned physical reflection triple. Extend the Schur-boundary invariant to product-preserving grouped/bank compressions so diffuse spectral directions can be paid before small physical pivots/minors.
continuity_ledger: Shared CLAIMS still marks full-target continuity open. In the present paid physical-reflection chamber, the source-pinned fixed-matrix compiler gives the full law a C_0 density at the same 6 sqrt(pi) height; if S!=0 the majority and minority sheet submeasures are also individually C_0. This is not promoted to a full-QFORM theorem.
